title: /integrations/ccm15
description: Instructions on how to integrate a Midea CCM15 module into Home Assistant.
body:
The **CCM15**  allows you to integrate [Midea CCM15](https://mbt.midea.com/hvac-goods/midea-products-category/vrfs/vrf-controller/central-controller-ccm-15) devices in Home Assistant.

There is currently support for the following device types within Home Assistant:

- [Configuration](#configuration)
- [Climate](#climate)

## Climate

Each data controller can support up to 64 `climate` devices.

## Removing the integration

This integration follows standard integration removal, no extra steps are required.
